text: Testing plays an important role in modern software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers also use test-driven development, where tests are written before the actual code. This method helps them think carefully about what the software should do. Running tests regularly allows teams to find problems early and fix them quickly. As a result, developers gain confidence in their work because they know their changes are safe. In short, good testing saves time, reduces stress, and leads to more reliable software for everyone.
